game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Mystic Forest – Owl Roost, a night-time owl roost: the wood elf archer must handle bog toads while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Squad Marcher: Loop through a squad list with for ally in squad so each member gets its job.
theme: Mystic Forest – Owl Roost: a night-time owl roost
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Object-like macros: build a valid C source file that prints 15. Put preprocessing before main; keep declarations and statements inside its body. Then test its compiler-factory route: Build the splitter at (2, 3), with the upper processing path on row 0 and lower path on row 5. Alternate items between A (upper) and B (lower); wait if the scheduled branch is blocked. Assemble components on both paths, then merge them at (8, 3) before the shared output. Deliver exactly 8 components (4 upper, 4 lower). Set the gold-socket controller batch to 8.
controls: Drag sprites onto the grid. R rotates new pieces. Set fork output directions and router conditions in the inspector. Splitters alternate; routers evaluate each item; mergers accept one waiting item at a time fairly. Set batch size, connect power, repair rounded conveyors, then Run or Step. Grid controls are the keyboard alternative.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Squad Marcher' (Week 5 slot 4), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Owl Roost'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: C Components, Keywords, Preprocessor and Organization

region.name: Mystic Forest
region.mood: airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.
Use Step to inspect state; Run checks the real outputs and goals.
Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Chain 9 consecutive correct decisions about squad_ready to power up the wood elf archer and open the spirit shrine.
source_lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
hint: Alternate items between A (upper) and B (lower); wait if the scheduled branch is blocked. Assemble components on both paths, then merge them at (8, 3) before the shared output. Branch contracts: A: 4 components via upper_4, upper_6 to output_shared; B: 4 components via lower_4, lower_6 to output_shared. Power the junctions and production machines. A blocked branch waits without losing items.
